text: Si Men neeminirii neɗɗanke on cellal e ɓuttu ekn, o welsindoo e jantagol Allah ɗoftoo Mo, o ɗuurnora ɗum, toownugol balaaje makko. Si ñawu non memii mo, maa baasal ekn, o wona torotooɗo Allah ko ɗuuɗi, hara himo woyto e Makko fii on bone, no O huncirana mo ɗum. Tawaa o yettataa Allah si O neeminii e makko, o muññotaako kadi e ko O jarriborta mo kon.
